settings: turnover >= Rs 50 Cr, price >= Rs 100, ATR >= 1%
gap up -> SELL, gap down -> BUY
rules: Universe (har din, sirf pichhle din tak ka data): pichhle 20 din ka average turnover >= Rs 50 Cr, aaj ka open >= Rs 100, ATR14 >= 1% of price.

Gap = aaj ka open - kal ka close. gap_atr = |gap| / ATR14. Sirf woh stocks jinka gap_atr 0.5 se 2 ke beech ho aur RVOL (9:15-9:20 volume / pichhle 14 din ka average) <= 1.5 ho. Inme se top 5 (sabse bada gap_atr pehle).
OR15 = 9:15-9:30 (pehli 15 candles) ka high aur low.

Gap up -> sirf SELL: 9:30 se 11:15 ke beech pehli candle jiska low OR15 low ko chhue -> entry OR15 low par (candle neeche khule to us candle ke open par). Gap down -> sirf BUY: high OR15 high ko chhue -> entry OR15 high (upar khule to open). Ek stock me din me ek trade.
Stop-loss: SELL = OR15 high + 0.1 x ATR14; BUY = OR15 low - 0.1 x ATR14. Agar entry se SL ki doori 0.15 x ATR14 se kam ya 1.0 x ATR14 se zyada ho to trade nahi.
Target = entry + 0.75 x (kal ka close - entry), yaani gap ka 75% wapas bharne tak. Target ka fayda SL ki doori se kam ho (reward/risk < 1) to trade nahi.

Exit: entry wali candle se check. Pehle SL dekho (ek hi candle me SL aur target dono = SL). SL ke paar gap se khule to us candle ke open par. Target limit order: candle target ke paar khule to us open par (behtar). Kuch na lage to 15:15 candle ke open par.
Qty = min(equity ka 1% risk / SL doori, 5 x equity / (5 x entry)); 20-din average volume ka max 1%.
Daily loss limit: din ka realized loss 3% equity tak pahunche to us din naya trade nahi.
Profit compound hota hai: har din ki position size us din ki shuruati equity se (start Rs 500,000).
Charges: brokerage min(Rs 20, 0.03%) har order, STT 0.025% sell, NSE 0.00307%, SEBI Rs 10/Cr, stamp 0.003% buy, GST 18%. Slippage 0.03% har side; stress test me 0.06%.
Koi lookahead nahi: din ke features sirf pichhle din tak ke; signal candle ke baad agli candle ke open par fill.
Bade gap (> 25%) ke baad us stock ko 21 din skip (shayad unadjusted split).
Period: 2021-10-01 -> 2023-12-29. DEV test: 2021-22 par rules dekhe, 2023 = validation (out-of-sample). 2024 ke baad ka data is test me nahi.
Stock list = AMFI Jun-2026 list (1,386 stocks): jo stocks 2021-26 me delist/merge hue ya chhote ho gaye woh data me nahi (survivorship bias) - results thode optimistic ho sakte hain.
formulas: TR = max(H - L, |H - kal close|, |L - kal close|); ATR14 = pichhle 14 din ke TR ka average
Avg turnover20 = pichhle 20 din ke (close x volume) ka average
Daily sigma = pichhle 14 din ke daily return (close / kal close - 1) ka standard deviation
RVOL = aaj 9:15-9:20 volume / pichhle 14 din ka 9:15-9:20 average volume
gap = aaj open - kal close; gap_atr = |gap| / ATR14
OR15 high / low = 9:15-9:29 candles ka max high / min low
Entry (SELL, gap up) = min(OR15 low, candle open); Entry (BUY, gap down) = max(OR15 high, candle open)
SL (SELL) = OR15 high + 0.1 x ATR14; SL (BUY) = OR15 low - 0.1 x ATR14; trade tabhi jab 0.15 x ATR14 <= |entry - SL| <= 1.0 x ATR14
Target = entry + 0.75 x (kal close - entry); reward / risk = |target - entry| / |entry - SL| >= 1.0
SL exit = SL price (entry candle me) ya SL aur candle open me se jo bura ho; target exit = target ya candle open me se jo behtar ho; warna exit = 15:15 open
Qty = floor(min(1% x equity / |entry - SL|, 5 x equity / (5 x entry)))
R = net P&L / (|entry - SL| x qty)
Max qty = 1% x 20-din average volume
Fill: BUY = price x (1 + 0.0003), SELL = price x (1 - 0.0003)
Brokerage = min(20, 0.03% x order value) har order; STT = 0.025% x sell; NSE = 0.00307% x (buy + sell); SEBI = 10 / 1 Cr x (buy + sell); stamp = 0.003% x buy; GST = 18% x (brokerage + NSE + SEBI)
Net P&L = side x (exit - entry) x qty - slippage - charges
Return % = net / us din ki shuruati equity x 100 (equity compound hoti hai)
Win rate = profit wale trades / total trades x 100
Profit factor = total profit / total loss
Max drawdown = equity ki pichhli peak se sabse badi % girawat
Sharpe = average(daily return) / std(daily return) x sqrt(252)
t-stat = average(trade return) / std(trade return) x sqrt(trades)

investment.max_per_stock: 5 x equity / 5, aur 1% of avg volume

data_note: Fyers 1-min data; stock list = AMFI Jun-2026 (survivorship bias). Prices adjusted with data/store/adjustments.csv.
